Show-ConnectionAlert.ps1:
[CmdletBinding()]
param()
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$runtime = 'C:/AI/DevSpace-Benchmark-20261031/connector-fixed'
if ($env:D_CHANNEL_ALARM_RUNTIME) { $runtime = $env:D_CHANNEL_ALARM_RUNTIME }
$statePath = Join-Path $runtime 'connection-alert.json'
$ackPath = Join-Path $runtime 'connection-alert-ack.json'
$eventPath = Join-Path $runtime 'connection-alert-ui.jsonl'
$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
function Read-AlertJson([string]$File) {
    try { return ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($File, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json) }
    catch { return $null }
}
function Write-AlertEvent([string]$Kind) {
    $row = @{utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); event=$Kind; episode=$script:episode; pid=$PID} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText($eventPath, $row + [Environment]::NewLine, $utf8)
}
$initial = Read-AlertJson $statePath
if ($null -eq $initial -or $initial.mode -ne 'ALARM') { exit 0 }
$script:episode = $initial.episode
$sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try { $id = ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($runtime.ToLowerInvariant())))).Replace('-', '') }
finally { $sha.Dispose() }
$created = $false
$mutex = New-Object Threading.Mutex($true, ('Local\DChannelAlert_' + $id), [ref]$created)
if (-not $created) { $mutex.Dispose(); exit 0 }
$script:recovered = $false
$form = New-Object Windows.Forms.Form
$form.Text = 'D通道连接异常提醒'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runtime 'TEST-MODE')) { $form.Text = '测试：D通道连接异常提醒' }
$form.ClientSize = New-Object Drawing.Size(530, 225)
$form.StartPosition = 'CenterScreen'
$form.FormBorderStyle = 'FixedDialog'
$form.MaximizeBox = $false
$form.MinimizeBox = $true
$form.TopMost = $true
$label = New-Object Windows.Forms.Label
$label.Location = New-Object Drawing.Point(22, 20)
$label.Size = New-Object Drawing.Size(485, 126)
$label.Font = New-Object Drawing.Font('Microsoft YaHei UI', 11)
$label.Text = $initial.message + "`r`n`r`n正在自动重连；每5秒提示一次。`r`n点击下方按钮可停止本次声音，自动重连继续。`r`n连接恢复后，本窗口会自动关闭。"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runtime 'TEST-MODE')) { $label.Text = '这是提醒功能测试，没有断开真实网络。' + "`r`n`r`n" + $label.Text }
$button = New-Object Windows.Forms.Button
$button.Text = '已知晓，停止声音'
$button.Location = New-Object Drawing.Point(150, 166)
$button.Size = New-Object Drawing.Size(230, 38)
$button.Add_Click({ $form.Close() })
$form.AcceptButton = $button
$form.Controls.Add($label)
$form.Controls.Add($button)
$timer = New-Object Windows.Forms.Timer
$timer.Interval = 5000
$tick = {
    $current = Read-AlertJson $statePath
    $ack = Read-AlertJson $ackPath
    $health = Read-AlertJson (Join-Path $runtime 'autostart-health.json')
    $healthy = $false
    $parsedUtc = [DateTime]::MinValue
    if ($null -ne $health -and [DateTime]::TryParse([string]$health.utc, [ref]$parsedUtc)) {
        $age = ([DateTime]::UtcNow - $parsedUtc.ToUniversalTime()).TotalSeconds
        $healthy = $health.status -eq 'SERVICE_READY_PLUGIN_LINK_NOT_VERIFIED' -and $health.local.ok -and $health.public.ok -and $health.local.issuer -eq $health.public.issuer -and $age -ge 0 -and $age -lt 300
    }
    if ($healthy -or ($null -ne $current -and ($current.mode -ne 'ALARM' -or $current.episode -ne $script:episode)) -or ($null -ne $ack -and $ack.episode -eq $script:episode)) {
        $script:recovered = $true
        Write-AlertEvent 'AUTO_CLOSED'
        $form.Close()
        return
    }
    [Media.SystemSounds]::Exclamation.Play()
    Write-AlertEvent 'SOUND_REQUESTED'
}
$timer.Add_Tick($tick)
$form.Add_Shown({ Write-AlertEvent 'WINDOW_SHOWN'; & $tick; if (-not $form.IsDisposed) { $timer.Start() } })
$form.Add_FormClosing({
    $timer.Stop()
    if (-not $script:recovered) {
        $ack = @{episode=$script:episode; acknowledged_utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $temp = $ackPath + '.' + $PID + '.tmp'
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temp, $ack, $utf8)
        Move-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Destination $ackPath -Force
        Write-AlertEvent 'ACKNOWLEDGED'
    }
})
try { [void]$form.ShowDialog() }
finally { $timer.Dispose(); $form.Dispose(); $mutex.ReleaseMutex(); $mutex.Dispose() }
